definitions.explanation: Describes produce or farming methods that do not use chemical pesticides. Often used as a modifier before nouns.

examples.japanese: {無農薬|むのうやく}{野菜|やさい}を{買|か}っている。
この{農家|のうか}は{無農薬|むのうやく}で{米|こめ}を{栽培|さいばい}している。
examples.english: This farmer grows rice without pesticides.

examples.japanese: {無農薬|むのうやく}{栽培|さいばい}は{手間|てま}がかかるが、{安全性|あんぜんせい}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Pesticide-free farming takes more effort, but offers higher safety.

notes:
{無農薬|むのうやく} means grown or produced without the use of chemical pesticides. Often used as a modifier (の-adjective) before nouns.

FORMS:
{無|む} (without) + {農薬|のうやく} (agricultural chemicals/pesticides).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無農薬|むのうやく}{野菜|やさい}: pesticide-free vegetables
- {無農薬|むのうやく}{栽培|さいばい}: pesticide-free cultivation
- {無農薬|むのうやく}{米|こめ}: pesticide-free rice
- {無農薬|むのうやく}で{育|そだ}てる: to grow without pesticides

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無農薬|むのうやく}: specifically no pesticides (narrower meaning)
- {有機|ゆうき}: organic (broader — also covers fertilizers, soil management, and certification standards)
- {減農薬|げんのうやく}: reduced-pesticide (uses fewer chemicals but not zero)
